source: Nueva lámina de tres robots ALS proporcionada por el titular en la conversación, con solicitud de reemplazar la mascota del sitio usando esas referencias.
preparation: Herramienta integrada imagegen, con transparent_background=true. Primera pose creada a partir de la referencia del titular; segunda pose con la primera como referencia de identidad y la lámina original como referencia de pose.
localProcessing: Sharp ya disponible: reducción suave a 320 px de ancho y PNG con paleta de 256 colores, conservando el alfa generado. Sin extracción manual del fondo ni dependencias nuevas en el sitio.
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent mascot PNG for the ALS DevStudio website, replacing a previous pixel-art robot. Input image: the user's latest uploaded reference sheet containing THREE white/gray ALS robots. This sheet is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE, not an image to reproduce as a sheet. Create ONE isolated full-body friendly ALS robot in a standing welcome pose. Follow especially the rounded robot at the LEFT of the sheet: large glossy near-black rounded face visor, two bright cyan/turquoise oval eyes, white pearl and soft gray armor, dark navy articulated joints, neat dark contour outlines, round silver/navy headphone-like ear pieces with subtle turquoise accents. Compact chibi proportions, warm approachable personality, polished 2D comic illustration with restrained smooth shading, NOT pixel art, not photorealism. One hand gently raised waving hello, other hand resting relaxed at its side. Both feet fully visible. Small exact 'ALS' lettering in dark navy on upper chest; no other text. Palette matches the attached reference: white, silver gray, navy, turquoise. Standing balanced upright in three-quarter view, facing the viewer. Subject occupies most of the canvas with a tight, even small transparent margin all around; crisp silhouette legible at 56–72px display width. Background must be genuinely TRANSPARENT with actual alpha=0 outside the character. No opaque checkerboard, no blueprint, grid, arrows, floor, cast shadow, scenery, labels, other robots or laptop. Single character only. Preserve the style and friendly robot identity of the supplied reference. This will be the reference character for a second seated laptop pose.

Use case: identity-preserve / pose variation. Asset type: second transparent PNG mascot asset for ALS DevStudio's website contact section. Inputs: the PORTRAIT single standing/waving ALS robot most recently generated is the CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE; the user's WIDE sheet with three robots is a supporting pose/style reference ONLY. Produce ONE character, the EXACT SAME friendly white and gray ALS robot from the portrait, now sitting cross-legged and working on an open laptop on its lap, inspired by the pose of the RIGHTMOST robot on the wide reference sheet. Preserve the portrait character's large glossy black rounded-square visor, two turquoise oval luminous eyes, white/silver armor, dark navy joints and outlines, round silver/navy headphone-like ear pieces with cyan rings, chibi proportions and polished smooth-shaded 2D comic illustration. Do NOT introduce hoodie clothing, a new helmet shape, extra armor detail or a different character. Both hands rest naturally over the laptop keyboard, short folded legs and both feet visible. Laptop is dark gray/navy with restrained silver edge and a small exact turquoise 'ALS' wordmark centered on its lid, A-L-S only. Friendly and focused, three-quarter view facing viewer. Composition is one compact complete seated robot plus laptop with a tight, small even TRANSPARENT margin; clear silhouette at 88–128px website display size. Output actual alpha transparency, alpha=0 outside the robot and laptop; keep white armor solid, not see-through. NO dark or blue backdrop, ambient glow cloud, floor, cast shadow, blueprint, arrows, checkerboard squares, labels, second character or frame. All background is truly transparent. No pixel art. Only this single isolated seated robot and laptop. Do not reproduce the wide reference sheet or the prior standing pose.
rights: Referencia suministrada por el titular para este uso. Los nuevos PNG son ilustraciones generadas a partir de ella, no recortes exactos. La integración no acredita la autoría de la referencia original.
